prompt.text:
원문에 근거한 비식별 연출 일러스트. 실제 사건 사진이나 증거처럼 표현하지 않는다.
장면: 특정 회사를 식별할 수 없는 일반 사무 공간. 행동: 경리 담당자가 신입사원에게 카드 사용 용도를 확인하는 대화. 인물 수: 2명.
이 글 전용 시각 선택: illustration, 두 사람과 카드 사용 확인 행동이 가까이 크게 보이는 구도, 색 남색/코발트, 표정 과장 없는 차분한 대화 표정. 다른 글에 이 장면을 재사용하지 않는다.
구도: 4:5, center_lower, contain. 여백: {"top":0.25,"right":0.05,"bottom":0.1,"left":0.05}.
이미지 안에 글씨, 제목, 숫자, 말풍선, 댓글, 로고, 서명, 워터마크, AI 연출 표시 문구를 넣지 않는다. 제목만 프로그램이 별도 합성하며 생성 이력은 내부 기록으로 보존한다.
추가하지 말 것: 실제 인물의 외모·성별·실명·회사 로고; 폭행이나 체포 장면; 추가 사건·새 숫자·돈 액수·댓글·여론 반응; 원문 사연의 진위 확정·실제 증거사진 주장.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate one square 1:1 editorial cover photograph, absolutely NO typography, lettering, digits, logos, labels, captions, marks, or watermark; headline and AI-staging label will be added later by code.
Fictional Korean adult workers, based on a source account about a 29-year-old sales new hire called in by accounting to explain corporate-card spending. Illustrative staging, not a real witness photo. Show the ordinary but tense card-use review meeting itself, no invented amount or allegation. Tight chest-up crop of TWO adults filling the frame: a 29-year-old male new hire in an electric cobalt shirt occupies the right foreground, and a female accounting colleague about 40 in charcoal occupies the left. Their faces are large, heads in the upper half, natural skin texture. The new hire holds one unbranded matte dark payment card near the desk and glances at it with restrained discomfort; the accounting colleague leans slightly toward the card with a composed firm expression and an open hand asking for explanation. Clear action and interpersonal tension at a glance, natural expressions, closed mouths, no pointing in faces, no shouting, no comedy, no melodramatic shock. Minimal dark blue-gray office backdrop, one small sharp vermilion accent object, cool daylight with strong directional contrast. Close camera, shallow depth of field. No beige look, no decorative shapes, no enormous empty background. Keep main face/hand/card action fully visible in upper 65 percent; lower 35 percent is naturally dark navy desk and torso foreground that will receive text, not blank empty space. People and their shoulders fill the left and right edges. No readable receipt, no screen text, no photo frames, no third person, no props implying theft, no handcuffs, no firing letter, no violence. Polished striking thumbnail composition, believable hands.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: square social-content COVER BACKGROUND only, without text. Absolutely no words, letters, numbers, logos, notices, watermarks or labels; exact Korean headline and AI-staging label will be added by code later.
Fictional Korean adult workplace staging based ONLY on a source passage where an accounting employee calls a 29-year-old sales new hire in to explain use of a corporate payment card. No actual identities, no invented monetary amount, no crime symbolism.
Create a much tighter dynamic editorial photo: the young adult male new hire in a vivid vermilion/rust-red plain shirt dominates the right two-thirds of the frame, head and upper torso very large, natural slightly tense brows, looking toward a plain dark corporate payment card held at chest level by an adult accounting colleague about 40 in the left foreground. The colleague's face is partially visible in three-quarter view, calm and firm. The new hire has one palm slightly open as he tries to explain, natural modest gesture and restrained expression, no shouting, no exaggerated shock, no cartoon-like emotion. The colleague is presenting the card for clarification; the card stays blank except a generic metallic chip. This specific behavior should make the situation immediately clear, not two people merely staring at each other.
Tight shoulder-height camera, candid near-cinematic realism, crisp skin and fabric, believable human anatomy. Faces in the upper half, card and hand gesture in the center above the lower third. People occupy the frame edge to edge with a sparse softly blurred blue-gray office background, cool daylight, strong yet natural contrast. Restricted point colors vermilion and deep teal; no beige, no stock-photo smiling, no empty margins. Lower 32 percent is naturally darker torso and desk foreground, textured but calm enough for a large three-line title overlay without covering faces or the card action. No letter, no readable document, no computer content, no third person, no branded store, no firing sign, no aggression. One simple scene with two fictional adults.
